2	import { db } from "~/db";
3	import {
4	  lessonProgress,

12	// ─── Progress Service ───
13	// Handles lesson completion tracking and course progress calculation.
14	// Uses positional parameters (project convention).
15	
16	export function getLessonProgress(userId: number, lessonId: number) {
17	  return db
18	    .select()
19	    .from(lessonProgress)
20	    .where(
21	      and(
22	        eq(lessonProgress.userId, userId),
23	        eq(lessonProgress.lessonId, lessonId)
24	      )
25	    )
26	    .get();
27	}
28	
29	export function getLessonProgressForCourse(userId: number, courseId: number) {
30	  const courseModules = db
31	    .select({ id: modules.id })
32	    .from(modules)
33	    .where(eq(modules.courseId, courseId))
34	    .all();
35	
36	  if (courseModules.length === 0) return [];
37	
38	  const courseLessons = db
39	    .select({ id: lessons.id })
40	    .from(lessons)
41	    .where(or(...courseModules.map((m) => eq(lessons.moduleId, m.id)))!)
42	    .all();
43	
44	  if (courseLessons.length === 0) return [];
45	
46	  return db
47	    .select()
48	    .from(lessonProgress)
49	    .where(
50	      and(
51	        eq(lessonProgress.userId, userId),
52	        or(...courseLessons.map((l) => eq(lessonProgress.lessonId, l.id)))!
53	      )
54	    )
55	    .all();
56	}
57	
58	export function markLessonComplete(userId: number, lessonId: number) {
59	  const existing = getLessonProgress(userId, lessonId);
60	
61	  if (existing) {
62	    return db
63	      .update(lessonProgress)
64	      .set({
65	        status: LessonProgressStatus.Completed,
66	        completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
67	      })
68	      .where(eq(lessonProgress.id, existing.id))
69	      .returning()
70	      .get();
71	  }
72	
73	  return db
74	    .insert(lessonProgress)
75	    .values({
76	      userId,
77	      lessonId,
78	      status: LessonProgressStatus.Completed,
79	      completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
80	    })
